panels.title: HTTP Request Rate
panels.description: Requests per second each service answers. A drop to zero while people are shopping means a service, or the gateway in front of it, is down. Runbook: https://github.com/AmirGHTo/ShopEasy/blob/main/README.md#servicedown

panels.title: HTTP Error Rate
panels.description: Requests per second answered with a server error (5xx), by service. Anything above zero for minutes is worth a look; start in Seq with @Level = 'Error' for that service. Runbook: https://github.com/AmirGHTo/ShopEasy/blob/main/README.md#shopservererrorshigh

panels.title: Orders Placed
panels.description: Orders accepted at the door since the services started (a counter, so it restarts from zero with the service). Flat while customers are ordering: the Order service or the gateway is not taking orders. Runbook: https://github.com/AmirGHTo/ShopEasy/blob/main/README.md#servicedown

panels.title: Outbox Pending
panels.description: Events saved in the Order outbox that RabbitMQ has not taken yet. Normally 0 or a few. Above 50 for 5 minutes: the broker is probably unreachable. Runbook: https://github.com/AmirGHTo/ShopEasy/blob/main/README.md#outboxbacklog

panels.title: Active Sagas
panels.description: Orders still being processed (not yet confirmed or cancelled). It rises with load and falls back; a number that stays high together with a rising oldest age means stuck orders. Runbook: https://github.com/AmirGHTo/ShopEasy/blob/main/README.md#orderstuck

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: The share of stock checks answered from the Redis cache. Low: slower orders and more load on Inventory. The cache is only an accelerator, so this is not an alert.

panels.title: Saga Duration (p95)
panels.description: How long an order takes from accepted to settled (95th percentile), by result. Rising: a step is slow; the Order Flow dashboard shows which one. Runbook: https://github.com/AmirGHTo/ShopEasy/blob/main/README.md#orderstuck

panels.title: HTTP Response Time (p95)
panels.description: The 95th-percentile answer time per service, health checks left out. The dots are requests with a trace behind them (exemplars): click one and choose Jaeger to see the trace, or the Seq link for its log lines. Sampling below 1.0 (Telemetry__SamplingRatio) keeps only some traces, so a dot can point at one that was not kept. A high value: see the runbook of ShopSlow.

panels.title: Order Outcomes (5m)
panels.description: How accepted orders ended in the last 5 minutes. 'failed' or release_not_confirmed need a person; many payment_declined cancellations point at the payment provider. Runbook: https://github.com/AmirGHTo/ShopEasy/blob/main/README.md#orderfailed

panels.title: Orders Refused at the Door (5m)
panels.description: Order requests refused before anything was saved, by reason. insufficient_stock is normal; catalog_unavailable and inventory_unreachable mean a dependency is failing. Runbook: https://github.com/AmirGHTo/ShopEasy/blob/main/README.md#dependencydown

panels.title: Payments (5m)
panels.description: What the payment provider answered in the last 5 minutes. More than 30% declined raises an alert (the simulated provider declines about 10%). Runbook: https://github.com/AmirGHTo/ShopEasy/blob/main/README.md#paymentsdeclinedhigh

panels.title: Confirmed Sales (last hour)
panels.description: The money of orders confirmed in the last hour. Zero while orders are placed: they do not reach 'confirmed'. Runbook: https://github.com/AmirGHTo/ShopEasy/blob/main/README.md#orderstuck

panels.title: Oldest Active Order (seconds)
panels.description: Age of the oldest order that is still being processed (0 when none). Above 600 seconds (10 minutes) raises OrderStuck; the timeout service should have settled it after 2. Runbook: https://github.com/AmirGHTo/ShopEasy/blob/main/README.md#orderstuck

panels.title: Dead Letters (messages in error queues)
panels.description: Messages that failed all their retries and wait for a person. Should be 0; above 0 for 5 minutes mails DeadLettersPresent. Which queue: the Dead Letter Monitor page (/deadletters).
